pa-policy-general-rules.txt:
Pennsylvania policy topic coding notes from reviewed examples:
- Code 325 (Health: professional health care licensing) for chiropractic licensure eligibility and related expiration rules.
- Code 2004 for municipal employee retirement systems and postretirement adjustments, including financing and Commonwealth reimbursements; the codebook explicitly places regulation of local employee retirement systems here.
- Code 1006 for special vehicle license plates commemorating an event or cause, even when the bill also makes an appropriation. The primary topic is the plate, not transportation generally or appropriations.
- Code 208 for laws requiring public agencies to hold meetings or hearings open to the public; open meetings and access to government information belong here.
